dct_description_sm: Objective  ArcticStat is a permanent, public and independent statistical database dealing with the countries, regions and populations of the Circumpolar Arctic.   ArcticStat was born out of the desire to facilitate comparative research on the socioeconomic conditions of the peoples of the Arctic by bringing together already existing data which are dispersed and often hard to find.  Sources  For the most part, the data indexed in ArcticStat come from national statistical agencies of the countries of the Arctic or their regional offices. These data are made public, produced on a recurrent basis, and are methodologically valid. In some cases, tables using data provided by statistical agencies were produced by the ArcticStat editorial team.
